title: PatchesFile
description:
`patches.yaml`: a child pack's changes to its parent's content, by id, applied in order when
the child is built (decision 0029). Only in a pack that `extends` another.

patches.description: The changes, applied one after another to the parent's built content.

flight_field.description: Targets a flight field in `flight.yaml`, by its `id`.

glossary_term.description: Targets a glossary entry, by its `term`.

item.description: Targets a panel item, as `panel/section/item`, by the item's `id`.

label.description: Targets a label in `labels.yaml`, by its dotted path, e.g. `roles.pf.title`.

message.description: Targets an alert message in `messages.yaml`, by its `id`.

op.description:
What the patch does to its target: `set`, `replace`, `remove`, `insert_before` or
`insert_after`.

panel_state.description: Targets a panel state in `panel-states.yaml`, by its `id`.

stage.description: Targets a stage in `phases.yaml`, by its `id`.

step.description: Targets a step in any list, by its `id`.

PatchOp.description: What a patch does to its target.

oneOf.description:
Changes some of the target's fields (`to`, a map; a field set to null is removed). A label
that is plain text takes its new text as `to`.
Puts `with` (one new entry, or a list of them) just before the target.
Puts `with` (one new entry, or a list of them) just after the target.
